regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your appreciated favor of August 24th. I have enrolled the Poor Souls specially for your intentions and mine. I am confident they will help us out of many troubles that would otherwise come to us. Thank you for your kind prayers. That is something all need very much. Thanks be to God for all things.
